full_judgment: 2. The suit was filed seeking declaration of title and khas possession and for the further relief that the auction sale in certificate case No. 615 BK of 1981-82 is fraudulent and void. The appellate Court upon allowing the appeal decreed the suit and thereupon directed the defendant Nos. 1-3 to vacate the land in suit within 30 days failing which plaintiff would be entitled to take delivery of possession through Court.
